title: Просьба Вики и заказ фламбе  (Vika's Request and the Flambé Order)

segments.t: In the dining room, Nastya shares a funny story from her own pregnancy before Vika asks her to keep the secret, and then Chef Barinov heads up to a guest room with a chicken breast flambé. Listen to the scene.
Я была беременна и всё забывала.
Не говори об этом никому, ладно?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'That is completely normal.' Nastya anchors the line on 'this', while 'normally' completes the thought.
Я была беременна и всё забывала.
'I was pregnant and kept forgetting everything.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'I used to forget' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'One day I ended up at the zoo.' In Russian, the idea of 'once' flows naturally into 'zoo' without extra filler words.
'Nastya, I have a favor to ask.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'Nastya' and finishing on 'request'.
Не говори об этом никому, ладно?
'Do not tell anyone about this, okay?' Vika anchors the line on 'not', while 'all right' completes the thought.
'I do not want to publicize it yet.' The grammar packs 'I' and 'to publicize' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Victor Petrovich, there is a new order here.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'proper name' before landing on 'order'.
'A guest ordered the room service.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'guest' before landing on 'number'.
'Fine, I will go up myself right now.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'all right', while 'will go' completes the thought.
'Did you call the chef to the room?' The plural past ending '-li' on the verb for 'to cause' covers a group or the polite 'you'.
'Did you order the chicken breast?' Notice how Russian expresses 'chicken' and 'ordered' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.

'What are you doing in there right now?' The grammar packs 'what' and 'are doing' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Я была беременна и всё забывала.
Не говори об этом никому, ладно?
And that wraps up Vika's conversation with Nastya and Barinov's trip upstairs. Notice the double negation in 'do not tell anyone about this'. Until next time!

lines.fragment: Я когда была беременна, я все время что-нибудь забывала
Не говори об этом никому, ладно?
